column1: # Known QBE builds by scripts/qbe_fingerprint.sh: fingerprint, tab, name. generate_build_info.sh writes a match to
# build-info.txt as qbe_known_as. QBE 1.3 writes different assembly under glibc and musl (its qsort comparisons leave
# ties unordered), so a release has one row per C library. A QBE with no row is unrecognised, not wrong.
